versions.changelog:
codewiki 1.2.0

- Added package-lock.json for deterministic dependency installs.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) with minor formatting and heading changes.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- No logic or workflow changes to the skill's behavior.

## codewiki 1.1.1

- No user-facing changes to documentation or logic.
- Internal implementation updated (scripts/codewiki.sh changed).
Add file:// protocol and local path support for codewiki.sh. Local directories are used directly without git clone/pull. Non-existent paths report an error.
Add --render <mkdocs|vitepress|both> and --serve [PORT] options; bundle render_docs.sh + render_mkdocs.py + render_vitepress.mjs for static-site rendering with isolated sandboxes.
